The '''Ulgo shipping facility''' was a shipping area on the lush [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] which was owned by [[House Ulgo]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], the shipping facility was discovered to contain several weapon stockpiles, which were subsequently destroyed by an individual affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
